// GREEN fixture for `control-plane-pii-free` — the lint MUST admit this.
// The cross-cell pointer carries OPAQUE IDS ONLY — a TenantId, a Region, an opaque slug. No
// name/email/body crosses the control plane (ADR-11, OQ-I).
pub struct CrossCellPointer {
    pub tenant_id: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
    pub opaque_slug: String,
}
